candidates.line: Your officer star feeds your seal: structure flows into learning, position into protection. Institutions treat you kindly and mentors appear inside them. Steady ascent is the wiring.
candidates.reading: A protected road runs underneath: structure keeps converting into learning for you, and position into shelter. Mentors appear inside hierarchies, promotions arrive without scandal, and your name gathers weight the slow, durable way. The only hazard is staying past a frame’s worth. Audit the ladder every few years, then climb on.
candidates.fused_line: In you the two move together, and you rise in rank and in learning at once.

domain_lines.Career: You also find your mentors inside the structures you join, and your name gathers weight the slow and lasting way.
domain_lines.Mind: You also learn well inside a frame like a school or a discipline, and you keep studying long after the course has ended.
